extras.text: Opens Can we populate null PV values using metadata?

Note 1. The PARAMETER_QTY field will display a dropdown list, with the highest ROUTE_PRIORITY value (as defined in the metadata) and the actual value from the initial setup. Planners will have the ability to modify this value.

2. A unique identifier combining the timestamp and username has been added to the UI.

3. Planners can disable any route by setting the PARAMETER_QTY value to ‘0’, which can be fetched from the metadata as the minimum value where SubjectAreaNm = 'Parameter', EntityNm = 'Parameter', BusinessRuleNm = 'Parameter_Config', and ColumnValueOnetxt = 'ItemInterplantRoute' and pass the 'COLUMN_VALUE_SEVEN_TXT' as minimum value.

4. ROUTE_PRIORITY Parameter is editable both for backend & frontend item classes and SPLIT_FACTOR is applicable only to frontend item classes. Please use the metadata condition where Subject_Area_Nm='Item_Route', Entity_Nm='Item_Route', Business_Rule_Nm='Parameter_Config_ItemClassItemCharExt', COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT='ItemInterplantRoute', COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TXT='ROUTE_PRIORITY','SPLIT_FACTOR'), if COLUMN_VALUE_THIRTEEN_TXT='N', then make PARAMETER_QTY field non-editable in UI else if it is 'Y' then it should be editable in UI.

5. Whenever a user modifies the ROUTE_PRIORITY for frontend item classes, the UI should display a warning indicating that the corresponding SPLIT_FACTOR value must also be updated.
